program_swing() |>
  dplyr::mutate(x = 1.5*x, y = 2*y) |>
  plot_swig(node_radius = 1, nudge_intervention_labels = 0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc(option = "light") +
  scale_color_mpxnyc(option = "manual", values = c("Community" = "black", "Individual" = "black", "intervention" = "black")) +
  theme_mpxnyc_blank()
